name: Mixed Trail Mix (Small Pouch)
descriptions: A resealable pouch of mixed nuts, seeds, and dried fruit — sweet, salty, and crunchy.
Portable snack good for a quick energy boost on the go; includes almonds, raisins, and pumpkin seeds.
effects: Crunchy, slightly sweet and salty; gives a sustained small energy lift.
The dried fruit provides quick sugars while the nuts offer steady satiety.

name: Honey Oat Granola Bar
descriptions: Individually wrapped granola bar made with oats, honey, and a few chocolate chips.
Compact snack that fits in a pocket; good for a quick bite between meals.
effects: Chewy and slightly sweet; satisfying without feeling heavy.
Provides a quick pick-me-up and mild sustained fullness from oats.

name: Smoky Beef Jerky
descriptions: Thin strips of cured, smoked beef preserved with salt and spices.
High-protein savory snack that’s chewy and intensely flavored.
effects: Savory and chewy with a smoky bite; very satisfying for meat lovers.
Salt content makes it taste fuller but can leave you a bit thirsty afterward.

name: Salted Potato Chips (Single Bag)
descriptions: Crispy thin-cut potato chips with a classic salted finish.
Light, crunchy snack that’s irresistibly biteable but quite salty.
effects: An immediate crunchy reward; heavy salt gives a strong savory punch.
Tasty but can leave you feeling slightly dehydrated after a few handfuls.

name: Salted Pretzel Twists
descriptions: Small bag of crunchy, lightly salted pretzel twists.
Simple, starchy snack that pairs well with dips or on its own.
effects: Mildly salty and pleasantly crunchy; comfortingly simple.
Starchy base gives moderate fullness but salt reduces hydration slightly.

name: Individually Wrapped Cheese Stick
descriptions: Single-serve sealed string cheese made from pasteurized milk.
Creamy, mildly tangy snack that’s good cold or at room temperature.
effects: Smooth, slightly salty dairy flavor; quickly satisfying and filling for a short time.
Protein-rich bite that pairs well with crackers or fruit.

name: Roasted Spiced Nuts (Small Tin)
descriptions: A mix of roasted almonds, cashews, and pecans tossed in a savory spice blend.
Hearty, crunchy, and aromatic — a rich snack that feels indulgent in small amounts.
effects: Warmly spiced and satisfying; the oils in the nuts leave a pleasant richness.
Good for steady energy and a lasting sense of satiety.

name: Single-Serve Hummus Cup with Pita Chips
descriptions: A sealed cup of creamy hummus paired with a small pack of crunchy pita chips.
Blend of chickpea, tahini, and lemon for a tangy, savory dip-and-crunch experience.
effects: Creamy and tangy; pairing with chips gives both moisture and crunch.
Satisfying and feels a bit more substantial than a plain bagged chip.

name: Wholegrain Savory Crackers (Pack)
descriptions: Thin, crunchy wholegrain crackers lightly seasoned with herbs and salt.
Neutral base snack that’s good alone or topped with spreads or cheese.
effects: Light and crisp with a faint herb note; eats quickly and pairs well with toppings.
Moderate fullness from the whole grains but slightly drying due to salt.

name: Spicy Pork Rinds (Single Bag)
descriptions: Air-crisped pork rinds seasoned with a zesty chili-spice blend.
Very crunchy and bold-flavored snack that’s high in protein and salt.
effects: Extremely crunchy with a strong savory punch; satisfying if you want something bold.
High salt content can make you crave water after eating.

name: Box of Chocolate Chip Cookies
descriptions: A small cardboard box containing six freshly baked chocolate chip cookies.
Soft center with crisp edges and generous chocolate chunks — a classic sweet snack.
effects: The warm, sweet aroma lifts your mood and brings a brief sense of comfort.
Each bite is chewy with pockets of melted chocolate that feel indulgent.

name: Fruit Gummies Pouch
descriptions: A pouch of assorted fruit-flavored gummy candies.
Chewy, brightly colored pieces with a sweet syrupy center.

name: Dark Chocolate Bar
descriptions: A single-portion dark chocolate bar with 70% cocoa content.
Slightly bitter, rich chocolate that feels decadent but not cloyingly sweet.
effects: A small piece provides a concentrated, satisfying chocolate flavor.
Smooth melt on the tongue that can sharpen your focus for a short while.

name: Caramel Popcorn Bag
descriptions: A medium bag of freshly caramel-coated popcorn.
Crunchy, sweet, and slightly sticky kernels — perfect for sharing while watching something.
effects: Crunchy sweetness that keeps your hands busy and offers casual comfort.
The caramel leaves a lingering sugary note on your lips.

name: Mini Brownie Pack
descriptions: A small foil tray containing three fudgy chocolate brownies.
Dense, moist, and intensely chocolatey — a concentrated dessert experience.
effects: Rich chocolateiness gives a strong sense of indulgence and quick energy.
The fudgy texture makes each piece feel like a miniature treat.

name: Assorted Candy Mix
descriptions: A clear pouch filled with a mix of hard candies, chewy toffees, and small chocolates.
A random, nostalgic assortment designed for quick snacking and sharing.
effects: A little sugar hit that brightens the moment and is easy to ration.
Varied textures keep the snack interesting bite to bite.

name: Granola & Honey Nut Bar
descriptions: A dense granola bar made with rolled oats, honey, and roasted nuts.
Sweet and slightly crunchy — more sustaining than pure candy.
effects: Provides a satisfying chew and a steady release of energy compared to pure sugar snacks.
The nutty texture and honey glaze feel wholesome yet indulgent.

name: Sparkling Energy Drink
descriptions: A chilled can of sweet, carbonated energy drink with fruity notes.
Formulated to give a quick boost; best consumed in moderation.
effects: A fizzy rush that cuts through drowsiness and provides an immediate lift in alertness.
The sweet carbonation leaves a bright, sharp aftertaste.

name: Snack Variety Box
descriptions: A curated box containing a selection of cookies, a brownie, a chocolate bar, a pouch of gummies, and a small bag of caramel popcorn.
Intended as a single giftable bundle for group sharing or multiple small treats over time.
effects: Opening the box reveals a little celebration of textures and flavors — great for sharing.
Eating from the box gives variety: quick candies for a spike and denser items for lasting satisfaction.

name: Greek Yogurt Cup
descriptions: Single-serve cup of thick Greek yogurt, plain or lightly sweetened.
Cool and tangy, good source of protein for a small meal boost.
effects: Creamy texture soothes the mouth and feels filling.
Protein-rich, leaving you satisfied for longer than a sugary snack.

name: Mixed Nuts Packet
descriptions: A small sealed pouch of roasted nuts (almonds, cashews, peanuts).
Crunchy and calorie-dense, with a slightly salty finish.
effects: Crunchy, savory and satisfying, but slightly salty.
Leaves a lingering richness that keeps hunger away but can feel a bit dry.

name: Granola Bar
descriptions: Oaty granola bar with honey and dried fruit, individually wrapped.
Portable and slightly chewy, good for quick energy between meals.
effects: Chewy texture with a sweet, nutty flavor that gives a quick pick-me-up.
Satisfies a snack craving without feeling heavy.

name: Carrot Sticks
descriptions: A small container of crisp, peeled carrot sticks ready to eat.
Fresh, slightly sweet and crunchy — a light, healthy snack.
effects: Crisp and refreshing bite with a clean vegetal sweetness.
Leaves you feeling lightly refreshed and a bit more alert.

name: Hummus Single-Serve (60g)
descriptions: Creamy chickpea hummus in a small plastic cup, seasoned with olive oil and lemon.
Savory and smooth, intended for dipping veggies or crackers.
effects: Savory, rich mouthfeel that pairs well with crunchy vegetables.
Adds a satisfying savory note that makes light snacks feel more substantial.

name: Chicken Salad Sandwich (pre-cooked)
descriptions: A ready-to-eat sandwich with cooked chicken, crisp lettuce, and a light dressing on whole-grain bread.
Refrigerated, made from cooked ingredients and intended to be eaten cold or at room temperature.
effects: Hearty and savory, satisfying hunger for a longer stretch.
Comforting textures from tender chicken and fresh bread.

name: Fresh Salad Cup (mixed greens, tomato, cucumber)
descriptions: A small clear container of mixed salad greens with sliced cucumber and cherry tomatoes, lightly dressed.
Bright, hydrating and light — good as a refreshing side or snack.
effects: Light, crisp bites that leave you feeling clean and refreshed.
Hydrating vegetables provide a noticeable cooling effect.

name: Family-sized salted potato chips bag
descriptions: A large sealed bag of thin, crispy potato chips heavily salted and lightly oiled.
Very crunchy and satisfying for sharing; leaves a greasy coating on fingers and a strong thirst afterwards.
effects: You get a loud, satisfying crunch with each bite; salt linger on your lips.
Fills the stomach quickly but provokes thirst and a greasy mouthfeel.

name: Single-serve potato chips
descriptions: A small pre-portioned pouch of thin potato chips — a one-person snack.
Portable and tasty, convenient for a short sugar/salt craving burst.
effects: A quick crunchy snack that momentarily satisfies but leaves you wanting more.
Salty finish that makes you reach for a drink.

name: Milk chocolate candy bar
descriptions: A soft, creamy chocolate bar with a sugary center — individually wrapped.
Offers a quick sugar rush and a pleasant melt-in-your-mouth texture.
effects: Instantly sweet and comforting; gives a short-lived boost of alertness.
Can leave a cloying aftertaste and promote a fast energy crash later.

name: Cola soda can (330ml)
descriptions: A classic carbonated cola in a chilled 330ml can. High in sugar and fizz.
Refreshing in the moment and very sugary; not very filling.
effects: Bubbly and sweet, it temporarily perks you up and quenches light thirst.
Leaves a sticky sweetness and can cause a quick sugar spike.

name: Caffeinated energy drink (250ml)
descriptions: A small can of energy drink — sweet, carbonated, and loaded with caffeine and taurine.
Designed to give a rapid energy lift; best used sparingly.
effects: A quick jolt of alertness and jittery wakefulness for a short while.
May leave a metallic aftertaste and make you feel restless if consumed in excess.

name: Instant cup noodles (ready-to-eat)
descriptions: A single-serving cup of instant noodles prepared with hot water; heavy on seasoning powder and oil.
Warm, slurpy and comforting but very high in sodium.
effects: Filling and warm, gives a feeling of comfort but leaves a lingering salty taste.
Can make you feel thirsty afterward and slightly bloated from the seasoning.

name: Cheese puffs single pack
descriptions: A lightweight snack of bright orange, airy cheese puffs dusted with artificial cheese flavor.
Messy fingers, pronounced cheesy aroma, and highly processed.
effects: Light and addictive mouthfeel; cheesy coating clings to lips and fingers.
Satisfies a nibble craving but is not particularly filling.

name: Beef jerky stick
descriptions: A single dried, seasoned strip of processed beef jerky — dense and salty.
High in protein compared with other snacks but very fibrous and salty.
effects: Chewy and savory, feels substantial despite small size; encourages slow, mindful chewing.
Leaves a dry mouth and a strong salty aftertaste.

name: Microwave buttered popcorn (bag)
descriptions: A bag of microwave popcorn popped with artificial butter flavor; fluffy but oily.
Archetypal movie snack — light yet easy to overeat because of the buttery flavor.
effects: Light and crunchy with a rich buttery aroma; pleasant to munch for extended periods.
Can feel greasy and slightly thirst-inducing after several handfuls.

name: dark chocolate square
descriptions: A single bite-sized square of 70% dark chocolate, slightly glossy with a faint cocoa dusting.
Rich and slightly bitter, wrapped in a tiny foil square.
effects: You pop the dark chocolate square into your mouth; it melts slowly, releasing deep cocoa and a faint roasted bitterness.
A quiet warmth and slight alertness creeps in from the small dose of caffeine and the sugar gives a quick pleasant uplift.

name: milk chocolate truffle
descriptions: A single round truffle with a soft, creamy milk chocolate center and a dusting of cocoa powder.
Slightly sticky to the touch, individually wrapped in thin paper.
effects: You bite into the truffle and the creamy center floods your mouth with sweet, milky chocolate.
The sugary richness leaves a pleasant, lingering comfort and a mild energy lift.

name: Candy Refill Bag
descriptions: A large bag filled with colorful hard candies, perfect for refilling a dispenser.
Contains enough candy to fully restock a standard candy dispenser.

name: Single Candy
descriptions: A small, round hard candy. Sweet and simple.
A little treat dispensed from a machine.
effects: You pop the candy in your mouth. It dissolves slowly, releasing a sweet fruit flavor.
A small moment of happiness.

name: salted pretzel knot (single)
descriptions: A small, crunchy pretzel knot with visible flakes of coarse salt and a glossy, baked surface.
Light and crisp, about the size of a palmable bite.
effects: You crunch the pretzel knot; the coarse salt and toasted wheat flavor hit immediately.
Its dryness makes you aware of thirst afterward, but the crunch is satisfyingly savory.

name: mini cheddar cheese cracker
descriptions: A small square cracker with a baked cheddar finish and a faint orange hue.
Buttery and slightly oily, a classic savory snack bite.
effects: You chew the cracker; sharp cheddar notes and a buttery crunch dominate.
It leaves a slightly salty aftertaste and a mild savory satisfaction.

name: honey-glazed roasted almond (single)
descriptions: A single almond roasted with a thin honey glaze that gives a glossy sheen.
Crunchy with a sticky-sweet exterior and a warm nutty core.
effects: You bite the almond; the glaze cracks and releases honeyed sweetness before the nutty roast comes through.
A small concentrated hit of fat and sugar that feels pleasantly filling for its size.

name: dried mango slice
descriptions: A thin, chewy slice of dried mango, bright amber in color and slightly translucent.
Naturally sweet and tender with a faint tang.
effects: You chew the dried mango; concentrated tropical sweetness and a chewy texture make it mouth-coating.
A little natural fruit sugar gives a quick lift and a small, pleasant rehydrating feeling compared to dry crisps.

name: mini chocolate chip cookie
descriptions: A small round cookie studded with tiny dark chocolate chips, slightly crisp at the edges.
Warm-baked aroma and a crumbly texture.
effects: You bite the cookie; buttery dough and pockets of melted chocolate offer a comforting sweet richness.
The sugary fat content leaves you pleasantly sated and perked up for a short while.

name: potato chip crisp (single)
descriptions: A single thin potato chip, ultra-crisp with visible salt crystals and an oily sheen.
Fragile and intensely salty, about the size of a fingertip when broken.
effects: You crunch the chip; an immediate rush of salt and fried potato flavor fills your mouth.
The dryness and salt make you noticeably thirstier afterward.

name: mini beef jerky bite
descriptions: A small, chewy strip of seasoned beef jerky, dark and slightly fibrous.
Dense and savory with a smoky peppered surface.
effects: You chew the jerky; concentrated meaty umami and a smoky, spiced chew dominate.
It feels filling and protein-rich but leaves your mouth dry, making you crave water.

name: candied caramel square
descriptions: A single soft square of golden caramel with a glossy surface and a slight stickiness.
Sweet and buttery, yields slightly when pressed.
effects: You chew the caramel; sweet, molten butter and a warm sugar pull coat your mouth.
It delivers a quick sugary rush and a lingering sweet film that makes you want to sip something.

name: salted caramel nut cluster (single cluster)
descriptions: A tiny cluster of nuts bound together with a thin caramel glaze and finished with a sprinkle of coarse salt.
Crunchy, sweet, and a bit savory in a single bite.
effects: You bite the cluster; the nuts crack and caramel folds into a salty-sweet combination that is both crunchy and chewy.
It feels indulgent and filling for its size, with a satisfying mix of fat, sugar, and salt.

name: Bag of Banana Gum
descriptions: A small bag filled with yellow banana-flavored gum balls.
Refill for a candy dispenser.

name: Bag of Hard Candies
descriptions: A bag of mixed red and green hard candies.
Refill for a candy dispenser.

name: Assorted Candy Bag
descriptions: A colorful bag containing a mix of all candy types.
Refill for a candy dispenser.

name: Mini Chocolate Bar Bag
descriptions: A bag of small chocolate bars.
